title: Time to diagnosis and treatment of obstructive sleep apnoea using mandibular jaw movement monitoring versus polysomnography: an open-label, multicentre, randomised, controlled trial
observations_or_assays: Time from randomization to diagnostic consultation
Time from randomization to treatment initiation
time_scope: Timing endpoints start at randomization; ESS at baseline and 3 months after diagnostic consultation, not 3 months after randomization.
excluded: ESS at 3 months post-randomization and mITT/imputed ESS supporting variants
Severity subgroups, quality of life, productivity, accuracy, economics and PAP adherence
population_or_material: The main randomized-analysis population of adults with suspected OSA in SUNSAS; retain the source-defined population for each timing endpoint.
requested_items: Main-analysis randomization-origin time-to-diagnosis/treatment medians and tests; ESS baseline and primary PP change/contrast three months after diagnostic consultation. Exclude post hoc at-home-PSG comparisons, mITT ESS sensitivity and post-randomization ESS timing as an alternate endpoint.
